'''''Nasturtium microphyllum''''', the '''onerow yellowcress''',<ref>{{PLANTS|id=NAMI2|taxon=Nasturtium microphyllum|accessdate=18 July 2015}}</ref> is an aquatic plant species widespread across [[Europe]] and [[Asia]], and naturalized in the [[United States]], [[Canada]], [[Mexico]], [[Central America]], [[Australia]], [[New Zealand]] and other places. It occurs in wet locations generally at elevations less than 1500 m. It has been reported from every Canadian province except [[Nova Scotia]] and [[Saskatchewan]]. In the US, it is fairly common in [[New England]], [[New York (state)|New York]], and [[Michigan]], with scattered populations in the southern and western parts of the country.<ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=250063804 Flora of North America v 7 p 490, ''Nasturtium microphyllum'']</ref><ref>Reichenbach, Heinrich Gottlieb Ludwig. 1832,  Flora Germanica Excursoria 683, ''Nasturtium microphyllum''</ref><ref>Löve, Áskell & Löve, Doris Benta Maria. 1948. Iceland University Institute of Applied Science Department of Agriculture Report, Reykjavik,  3: 109, ''Rorippa microphylla''</ref>
